hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import re, sys, json
readme = 'readme.txt'
try:
    with open(readme, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()
except FileNotFoundError:
    sys.exit(0)

has_next = bool(re.search(r'^= next =$', content, re.MULTILINE))
if not has_next:
    match = re.search(r'^= \d+\.\d+', content, re.MULTILINE)
    if match:
        content = content[:match.start()] + '= next =\n* \n\n' + content[match.start():]
        with open(readme, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(content)
        msg = 'Changelog: created = next = section in readme.txt — add your entry now.'
    else:
        msg = 'Changelog reminder: add an entry to the = next = section in readme.txt.'
else:
    next_block = re.search(r'^= next =\n(.*?)(?=^= \d|\Z)', content, re.MULTILINE | re.DOTALL)
    entries = [l for l in (next_block.group(1) if next_block else '').splitlines() if l.strip() and l.strip() != '*']
    if not entries:
        msg = 'Changelog reminder: = next = section in readme.txt is empty — describe what changed.'
    else:
        sys.exit(0)

print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
"
